Implements
[spec 0006](../../specs/features/004-release-polish/specs/0006-tray-reminders.md)
under decisions 1, 3, and 21 to 24 in the
[feature README](../../specs/features/004-release-polish/README.md). Source
and executable tests are canonical after implementation. Ticket numbers are
shared across the release-polish plans; these continue from POLISH-062.

The tickets come from a first-time owner's walk on a fresh rc.5 install on
2026-11-08, which stalled between saving a TMDB key and building a channel.

## Reconnaissance

One server change in catalog scan and media roots, the rest in the web
desktop shell, one browser-suite change, and a docs batch. No database,
scheduling, playout, or provider change.

## Tickets

### POLISH-063: Gregg, drawn

**Status**

Complete on 2026-11-11. Four takes were drawn and compared side by side at
48 px and 16 px, light and dark; the provisional pick is take C (heavy ink: a
squat 1950s set with thick outlines, a barrel screen, a cap-brim visor, and
splayed legs), finished as `GreggFigure` and `GreggHead` under
`apps/web/src/tray-reminders/drawings/` with the smoke wisp animated by
`tray-reminders.css` and still under reduced motion. The takes not picked
stay outside the repository; the owner's final pick comes at the end of the
run (POLISH-069).

**Goal**: Gregg exists as kraziTV's own drawing. The run builds with a
provisional take and the owner picks the final one at its end.

**Scope**: Draw three or four distinct takes on the spec's description (beige
CRT, rabbit ears, half-lidded screen face, green eyeshade visor, loosened tie,
cigarette) with the same component names and props, so one take can replace
another by swapping files, and keep them side by side at 48 px and 16 px on
the XP balloon's background, light and dark. Finish a provisional pick as
inline SVG drawings, one per file, in `apps/web/src/tray-reminders/drawings/`:
the 48 px balloon figure with a separately addressable smoke wisp, and the
16 px tray head, which must still read as a TV with a cigarette at that size.
Animate the smoke with CSS only while `prefers-reduced-motion` is not
`reduce`.

**Out of scope**: Using him in the tray or balloon (POLISH-065). Any paperclip
shape, wire eyebrows, or other Office Assistant trait.

**Blocking dependencies**: None. The owner's final pick is POLISH-069, at
the end of the run. Until then the takes not picked are kept outside the
repository, never as unused components under `src/`.

**Implementation notes**: Use the `animate` skill for the smoke: slow,
low-contrast, opacity and transform only. Keep each drawing a plain React
component returning `<svg>` with `aria-hidden`; the balloon names him in
text.

**Verification**: The provisional pick and its reason recorded in the PR. A render test that
each drawing mounts and the smoke element carries the reduced-motion rule.
`npm run typecheck`, `npm run lint`, `npm run audit:strict`.

**Docs impact**: None until POLISH-068.

### POLISH-064: Look up every outstanding file

**Status**

Complete on 2026-11-11. The `failed` lookup retry scope became `outstanding`
with an optional root, whose all-roots form answers with the items its jobs
look up and the busy roots it skipped, and Media Library shows each root's
"N not looked up" and offers **Look up on TMDB**. Calling the all-roots form
from Set up TMDB is POLISH-066, and the wiki's Media Library page is POLISH-068.

**Goal**: The server can look up every file that was never looked up or
whose lookup failed, on one root or all of them, and Media Library offers it.

**Scope**: Replace the lookup retry scope `failed` with
`{ scope: "outstanding", mediaRootId?: string }`: items that are retryable
and either have no decision row, are `not_looked_up`, or match
`isFailedLookup`. With a root it behaves as `failed` did. Without one it
starts a retry on every enabled root that has outstanding items and no
running job, and answers with how many items its started jobs will look up
and how many roots it skipped as busy; with no key it refuses with
`tmdb_key_missing`. Add `notLookedUp` to `RootMatchCounts`. In Media Library,
show "N not looked up" in the Matches column beside the other counts, and
rename **Retry failed lookups** to **Look up on TMDB**, enabled while the
root is enabled, a key is set, and `notLookedUp + failedLookups > 0`.

**Out of scope**: Starting lookups on key save (POLISH-066). Any change to
what a scan enriches.

**Blocking dependencies**: None.

**Implementation notes**: Remove `failed` rather than keeping both: Media
Library's menu is its only caller. Confirm during this ticket that a normal
rescan looks up `not_looked_up` items and that a scan reads the key when it
reaches enrichment, not when it starts; record what you found in the PR, since
the spec's busy-root behavior relies on it.

**Verification**: Server tests for the scope with and without a root, a busy
root, a disabled root, a root with nothing outstanding, and no key. Web tests
for the count and the menu item's enabled states. The full check list in
`AGENTS.md`.

**Docs impact**: `GLOSSARY.md`'s **Lookup retry** entry, in this ticket:
"a root's failed lookups" becomes a root's outstanding lookups.
`wiki/Media-Library.md` and `wiki/Troubleshooting.md` name **Look up on
TMDB** (folded into POLISH-068).

### POLISH-065: Tray reminders, with Gregg

**Status**

Complete on 2026-11-11. `tmdb-reminder/` became `tray-reminders/`: a list of
reminders the shell evaluates in order, one tray icon drawn as Gregg's head,
one balloon with Gregg and his quip beside the title, a per-reminder
once-per-start automatic open, and per-reminder stored choices, with reminder 1
keeping `krazitv.tmdbReminder`. The wiki's The Desktop page is left for
POLISH-068, as planned.

**Goal**: The tray's one reminder becomes the first entry of a reminder list
that any later reminder joins as data, shown with Gregg.

**Scope**: Move `tmdb-reminder/` to `tray-reminders/`. A reminder is a
condition, its words (title, sentence, quip), and a main action; the shell
evaluates them in the spec's order. One tray icon, Gregg's head, shows while
any reminder shows, labelled with the balloon it would open; reminder 1 shows
whenever no key is set but holds, and so opens by itself, only once a media
root exists. One balloon at a time. A reminder opens by itself at most once
per desktop start, the first time its condition holds while it is due, which
may be mid-session. Each reminder stores its own choice; the TMDB reminder keeps
`krazitv.tmdbReminder` and its stored shape, so existing choices carry over.
Gregg sits beside every balloon's title, his quip under it. Words live in one
`tray-reminder-words.ts`. Reminder 1 ships here with its spec words and quip.

**Out of scope**: Reminders 2 and 3 and the lookup status balloon
(POLISH-066, 067).

**Blocking dependencies**: POLISH-063.

**Implementation notes**: Keep the balloon's current focus rule (an automatic
open never takes focus) and its Escape and ✕ handling. The "decided once"
ref becomes a per-reminder "opened by itself this start" set. Reach for a
reminder record type only as far as three entries need; no registry.

**Verification**: Web tests: reminder 1's existing tests keep their
behavior, except that it now opens by itself when its condition first holds
mid-session, such as right after the first media root is added, which gets
its own test; a stored **Don't remind me** from before the move still
silences it; priority picks the first holding reminder; a condition that
first holds mid-session opens once and not again after closing.
`npm run test` and the check list.

**Docs impact**: `wiki/The-Desktop.md` (folded into POLISH-068).

### POLISH-066: Saving a key looks the library up

**Status**

Complete on 2026-11-11. Saving a key in Set up TMDB now starts the all-roots
outstanding lookup and Account Settings says how many files it looks up, Set
up TMDB and Media Library's scans and lookups refresh the shell's roots read,
which polls while a job runs, and the tray shows running lookups as a status
that opens only when clicked. No server change was needed: a retry's status
already counts done of total. The tray's **Look them up** is POLISH-067's, and
the wiki's Set Up TMDB page is POLISH-068's.

**Goal**: Saving a TMDB key starts the lookups, and the tray shows them
running.

**Scope**: After a successful save, the Set up TMDB task calls the
all-roots `outstanding` lookup and words its answer: "kraziTV is looking up
1,234 files on TMDB. Keep working; the tray will tell you when it's done.",
or only that the key is saved when nothing started. A failed second call
leaves the key saved and says nothing extra; reminder 2 covers it. Whenever
the Set up TMDB task's lookup, the tray's **Look them up**, or Media
Library's **Look up on TMDB** or a scan starts a job, the shell refreshes its
`/media-roots` read: the shell passes its refresh down through
`ProgramContents` to Account Settings and Media Library as a callback, the
way it passes `tmdbKey.refresh` as `onTmdbKeyChanged`, and the tray calls it
directly. The shell then polls `/media-roots` every few seconds while any
root's job runs. While a
lookup runs, the tray icon shows with the tooltip "Looking up files on TMDB:
340 of 1,234", and clicking it opens a status balloon with that count, Gregg's
running quip, and a close button. It never opens by itself.

**Out of scope**: Reminders 2 and 3 (POLISH-067).

**Blocking dependencies**: POLISH-064, POLISH-065.

**Implementation notes**: The key route stays a key route; the web makes the
second call, as the spec's Technical Behavior says. Take the progress count
from the job's existing scan status counts; if they cannot give "done of
total" for a retry, add that to the status in this ticket rather than
guessing in the web.

**Verification**: Web tests for both confirmation sentences, the failed
second call, each job starter refreshing the shell's roots read, and the
tray's running state and polling stop. The check list.

**Docs impact**: `wiki/Set-Up-TMDB.md` (folded into POLISH-068).

### POLISH-067: Files not looked up, and collections ready

**Goal**: When lookups end, the tray says what is left or what kraziTV found,
and one click takes the owner on.

**Scope**: Reminder 2, "N files haven't been looked up on TMDB", holds while a
key is set, no job runs, and some enabled root has `notLookedUp > 0`; **Look
them up** starts the all-roots lookup. Reminder 3 holds while a key is set,
no job runs, nothing is left to look up, and recommendations exist; its title
counts series as "shows" and franchises as "movie series", leaving out a kind
with none. It is due only when there are more recommendations than when the
owner last answered it (decision 24), stored with its choice. **Make
collections** opens Collections with the Discover dialog open, through a new
`ProgramTask` beside `set-up-tmdb`. The shell reads recommendations only
while reminder 3's other conditions hold.

**Out of scope**: Changing Discover itself.

**Blocking dependencies**: POLISH-066.

**Implementation notes**: The Discover task follows the counted-request
pattern `set-up-tmdb` already uses in `desktop-shell.tsx`, so a repeat
request reaches an open Collections window.

**Verification**: Web tests for each condition, the title's kind counting,
the "more than last answered" rule, and **Make collections** opening
Discover with Collections already open and closed. The check list.

**Docs impact**: `wiki/First-Run.md` (folded into POLISH-068).

`npm run agents:check`, `npm run format`.

**Docs impact**: This ticket is the docs impact.

### POLISH-069: Gregg's final pick

**Goal**: The owner picks the Gregg kraziTV ships, and the spec is done.

**Scope**: Show the owner a drafts sheet with every take from POLISH-063 at
48 px and 16 px, beside the provisional one in a real balloon. If the pick
differs, swap the drawing files in `apps/web/src/tray-reminders/drawings/`
for that take, rerun the gate, and retake every wiki screenshot that shows
Gregg. Then set spec 0006 and the feature README to Implemented.

**Out of scope**: New takes or changes to the reminders.

**Blocking dependencies**: POLISH-068.

**Implementation notes**: The takes not picked stay outside the repository
until the pick, never as unused components under `src/`. Because every take
has the same component names and props, a swap changes only the drawing
files.

**Verification**: The pick recorded in the PR. On a swap, the full check list
in `AGENTS.md` and the render test from POLISH-063, and the retaken
screenshots show the picked take. `npm run plan:status:check`.

**Docs impact**: Spec 0006's `Status:` line and the feature README's.
